summary.text: Jamila Woods is a Democratic member of the Maryland House of Delegates from District 26, where she has served since January 11, 2023, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. She is a business executive.

paragraphs.text: Woods was born in Chesilhurst, New Jersey.

She earned a bachelor's degree in political science from Howard University in 1990, a master's degree in divinity from Howard in 1999, and a master's degree in social work from the University of Maryland, Baltimore in 2002.

Her career experience includes serving as president and CEO of Gabriel's Lyric Therapeutic Services, LLC, as pastor of Jabez Christian Community Church, and as an investigative hotline social worker with the Child and Family Services Agency in Washington, D.C.
For 2025-2026 she is assigned to the Health & Government Operations Committee.
